name: N2N Connect Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约公告，所发布的公告主要为财务报告、股息派发及公司治理事项。公司更改财政年度结算日，并宣派股息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contract for its business segments; announcements were mainly financial reports, dividend payments, and corporate governance matters. The company changed its financial year end and declared dividends.
